actions.action: Check soil moisture with finger 3-5 cm down
Water thoroughly until it drains if soil is dry
Soak pot in a bucket for 20-30 minutes if soil has pulled away from pot
If soggy, slide plant out and inspect roots for rot
Trim black mushy roots and replace with fresh potting mix if rot found
Move plant out of direct sun to bright shaded spot
Cut fully brown leaves off at the base
Trim brown edges on partly green leaves
Water when top few cm are dry or leaves begin to droop
Repot into slightly larger container with fresh mix if rootbound

reason: The answer names thirst plus sun scorch as the main issues and advises a thorough watering and moving it out of direct sun, which matches the confirmed fix; nothing in it is harmful.
